name: Deferred Point Lighting via Depth/Normal Reconstruction
definition: A lighting technique that reconstructs world-space position and normal from screen-space depth and normal textures (G-buffers) to calculate per-pixel point lighting attenuation and diffuse shading.
summary: Deferred Point Lighting via Depth/Normal Reconstruction calculates accurate per-pixel point lighting by explicitly reconstructing world-space position from depth to compute distance-based attenuation, unlike methods relying on pre-computed coefficients.
